cfs.packages.Definition

Describes the particular file packages inside the bucket.

Available as lseg.data.delivery.cfs.packages.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    package_name: str | None = None,
    package_id: str | None = None,
    package_type: str | None = None,
    bucket_name: str | None = None,
    page: int | None = None,
    included_total_result: bool = False,
    skip_token: str | None = None,
    page_size: int = 25,
    included_entitlement_result: bool = False,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
package_name str | None No None Package name for partial match searching.
package_id str | None No None Package ID.
package_type str | None No None Package type.
bucket_name str | None No None Package bucket name.
page int | None No None The offset number that determines how many pages should be returned.
included_total_result bool No False The flag to indicate if total record count should be returned or not.
skip_token str | None No None Skip token is only used if a previous operation returned a partial result. If a previous response contains a nextLink element, the value of the nextLink element will include a skip token parameter that specifies a starting point to use for subsequent calls.
page_size int No 25 The number of package that will be returned into a single response.
included_entitlement_result bool No False The flag that enables the entitlement checking on each package.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the client file store to retrieve the previously defined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

TypeData instance.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the previously defined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None User-defined callback function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response

Returns

TypeData instance

Example

from lseg.data.delivery import cfs
definition = cfs.packages.Definition()
packages = definition.get_data()

# Using get_data_async

import asyncio
task = definition.get_data_async()
response = asyncio.run(task)
